email_confirmation.builder: efbBuilderApi.newItems("email") (formPatch carries email_to / sendEmail only when the form has no recipient)
email_confirmation.rule: A new e-mail field becomes the recipient (noti 1, email_to = its id_, sendEmail true) when email_to names no e-mail field of the form; email_to holds one field, later e-mail fields stay off. Off: noti 0 on the field (and email_to "" when it was the recipient). Saved forms keep their choice.
email_confirmation.sent_when: the visitor typed a valid address in that field and the site can send e-mail; an empty optional or invalid address sends nothing
email_confirmation.server: Builder_Api::field_templates("email") (noti 1 + form_patch; args recipient => false for a second e-mail field), Builder_Api::email_recipient_default($rows) / efb_email_recipient_default_efb($rows) for a new form

rules: import always creates a new form
ids kept unless invalid or duplicated (then remapped through efb_form_package_remap_ids)
the builder / AutoPilot save path runs on every import
secrets and site-only keys never exported
an add-on block is dropped with a notice when its add-on is not active
form_package.ui: none in core (the plugin Easy Form Builder Data Tools)

portal_core.never: an assistant links to the portal page only; it never asks for or enters a sign-in code and never reads an owner's entries
